overall_goal: Prepare the egg mixture by cracking, seasoning, and whisking the eggs

goals.rationale: The person opens the fridge, takes out multiple eggs from the egg box, and places them into a colander on the counter.

goals.description: Get a mixing bowl from the cupboard
goals.rationale: The person opens a cupboard, takes out a white bowl, and positions it on the kitchen counter.

goals.description: Crack the first batch of eggs into the bowl
goals.rationale: The person cracks several eggs one by one, pours the raw eggs into the bowl, and discards the shells into the food waste bin.

goals.description: Crack the remaining eggs into the bowl
goals.rationale: The person continues to crack the rest of the eggs into the bowl and throws the remaining shells into the bin.

goals.description: Remove eggshell fragments and whisk the eggs
goals.rationale: The person uses a fork to fish out a piece of eggshell from the bowl, then stirs the egg yolks and whites together.

goals.description: Season the eggs with salt and whisk
goals.rationale: The person adds salt to the egg mixture and whisks it again to ensure the seasoning is well distributed.

goals.description: Give the eggs a final whisk
goals.rationale: The person picks up the bowl and gives the egg mixture one last stir with the fork before cooking.
